context_requirements: Active TGF-beta signaling with intact SMAD2/3 pathway
Expression of TGFBR1/TGFBR2 and ligand availability
Epithelial or mesenchymal lineage with TGF-beta-responsive transcriptional program
falsifiers: No change in CDKN1A or SERPINE1 at 6 or 24 h in any line
No decrease in MYC or proliferation genes at 24 h
Strong interferon or unfolded protein response signature instead of TGF-beta target changes
Uniform strong response across all nine lines including non-responsive lineages

evidence.supports: TGF-beta receptor inhibitor SB431542 blocks p21 induction, showing TGF-beta pathway dependence for CDKN1A expression
TGF-beta receptor inhibitor inhibits collagen synthesis and Smad2 phosphorylation in hepatic stellate cells

changes: Moved SMAD3 from proximal_up to proximal_down and late_down: inhibiting TGF-beta receptor reduces SMAD3 transcriptional activity and often its expression.
Moved MMP2 from proximal_up to proximal_down and late_down: TGF-beta receptor inhibition decreases MMP2 expression.
Moved TIMP2 from late_up to late_down: TGF-beta signaling induces TIMP2, so inhibition lowers it.
Removed COL1A1 and COL4A1 from proximal_down and placed them in late_down: collagen transcriptional repression is a delayed response to TGF-beta receptor inhibition.
Removed SMAD3 from late_up: SMAD3 is not expected to increase after TGF-beta receptor inhibition.
Removed MMP2 from late_up: MMP2 is not expected to increase after TGF-beta receptor inhibition.
Removed TIMP2 from late_up: TIMP2 is not expected to increase after TGF-beta receptor inhibition.
